        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
        import configuration_shortlist
        from reporting.configuration_shortlist import ShortlistCriteria
        from reporting.configuration_shortlist_html import collect_browser_catalog

        catalog = collect_browser_catalog(
            ROOT,
            ShortlistCriteria(as_of="2026-08-02"),
        )
        configuration_shortlist._apply_reviewed_gap_states(catalog, ROOT)
        configurations = {
            item["configuration_code"]: item
            for item in catalog["configurations"]
        }
        stepway = configurations[
            "sandero_stepway_iii_expression_ecog120_automatic"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            stepway["comparison_values"]["front_track::all"]["display_value"],
            "źródło nie podaje",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            stepway["equipment"]["gear_shift_indicator"]["availability_status"],
            "not_applicable",
        )
        spring = configurations["spring_extreme_electric100_automatic"]
        components = {item["code"]: item for item in spring["price_components"]}
        self.assertEqual(components["spring_city_package"]["amount"], 1800.0)
        self.assertEqual(components["spring_power_package"]["amount"], 3000.0)
        self.assertEqual(
            components["spring_type2_charging_cable_option"][
                "review_classification"
            ],
            "source-conflict",
        )

    def test_interface_uses_reviewed_labels_without_counting_context_prices(self) -> None:
        selection = (
            ROOT / "tools/reporting/configuration_shortlist_selection.js"
        ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        pricing = (
            ROOT / "tools/reporting/configuration_shortlist_v12_pricing.js"
        ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn('status === "not_applicable"', selection)
        self.assertIn('"nie dotyczy"', selection)
        self.assertIn("state.review_message", selection)
        self.assertIn("unknownComponentStatus", pricing)
        self.assertIn("component.review_message", pricing)
        self.assertIn("review_candidate_amount_pln", pricing)

        report = payload(
            ROOT / "data/reporting/reviewed_gap_state_materialization.json"
        )
        contextual = [
            item for item in report["price_states"]
            if item["classification"] == "context-unmodeled"
        ]
        self.assertTrue(all(item["candidate_amount_pln"] for item in contextual))
        master = rows(ROOT / "data/master/commercial_item_configurations.csv")
        contextual_keys = {
            (item["commercial_item_code"], item["configuration_code"])
            for item in contextual
        }
        mapped = {
            (row["commercial_item_code"], row["configuration_code"]): row
            for row in master
        }
        self.assertTrue(
            all(mapped[key]["amount"] == "" for key in contextual_keys)
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
""",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def patch_state_tests() -> None:
    registered = ROOT / "tests/test_registered_source_completeness_reconciliation_20260802.py"
    text = registered.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    start = text.index("    def test_project_state_advances_to_materialization_package")
    end = text.index("\n\n\nif __name__", start)
    replacement = """    def test_completed_review_remains_preserved_after_materialization(self) -> None:
        state = payload(ROOT / "project/state.json")
        self.assertEqual(
            state["reference_delivery"]["name"],
            "Registered Source Completeness Reconciliation",
        )
        self.assertEqual(state["reference_delivery"]["pull_request"], 448)
        self.assertEqual(
            state["current_package"]["package_id"],
            "reviewed_gap_state_materialization_001",
        )
        self.assertEqual(state["current_package"]["status"], "complete")
        self.assertEqual(
            state["next_package"]["package_id"],
            "reviewed_gap_interface_validation_001",
        )
        self.assertEqual(state["baseline"]["tests"], 1786)
"""
    registered.write_text(text[:start] + replacement + text[end:], encoding="utf-8")

    sandero = ROOT / "tests/test_sandero_residual_source_closure_20260801.py"
    text = sandero.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    old = """        self.assertEqual(state["reference_delivery"]["name"], "Interface Source Coverage Repair")
        self.assertEqual(state["reference_delivery"]["pull_request"], 447)
        self.assertEqual(
            state["current_package"]["package_id"],
            "registered_source_completeness_reconciliation_001",
        )
        self.assertEqual(state["current_package"]["status"], "complete")
        self.assertEqual(
            state["next_package"]["package_id"],
            "reviewed_gap_state_materialization_001",
        )
"""
    new = """        self.assertEqual(
            state["reference_delivery"]["name"],
            "Registered Source Completeness Reconciliation",
        )
        self.assertEqual(state["reference_delivery"]["pull_request"], 448)
        self.assertEqual(
            state["current_package"]["package_id"],
            "reviewed_gap_state_materialization_001",
        )
        self.assertEqual(state["current_package"]["status"], "complete")
        self.assertEqual(
            state["next_package"]["package_id"],
            "reviewed_gap_interface_validation_001",
        )
"""
    if old not in text:
        raise RuntimeError("sandero state contract marker missing")
    sandero.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8")


def update_state() -> None:
    state = json.loads(STATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    state["updated_on"] = "2026-08-02"
    state["phase"] = CURRENT_PACKAGE["name"]
    state["reference_delivery"] = {
        "name": "Registered Source Completeness Reconciliation",
        "pull_request": 448,
        "head_sha": "7abf536dd07e3417a8604196ecb469a9d2d9b70a",
        "quality_run": 30721504297,
    }
    state["baseline"]["tests"] = 1786
    state["current_package"] = CURRENT_PACKAGE
    state["next_package"] = NEXT_PACKAGE
    STATE.write_text(
        json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def main() -> int:
    changed = update_master_prices()
    import_rows(changed)
    payload = materialization_payload(changed)
    write_reports(payload)
    patch_configuration_shortlist()
    patch_selection_js()
    patch_pricing_js()
    write_tests()
    patch_state_tests()
    update_state()
    print(
        "Reviewed gap materialization applied: "
        f"{len(changed)} price rows, "
        f"{len(payload['comparison_states'])} comparison states, "
        f"{len(payload['price_states'])} price states."
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
